extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, stakeholders, and members of the public searching Federal Register documents referencing the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (BIL)
extracted.subtask_description: Search-results listing of Federal Register documents that mention or implement provisions of the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law (IIJA/BIL). The page aggregates titles, abstracts, excerpts, document types, dates, and links for items matching the query 'Bipartisan Infrastructure Law.'
